findings.issue: Task 4 added a NEW public method `logEventBlocking(...)` to EventService. EventService.java is listed in tech-spec.md:50 'Architecture / No changes (zero-touch contract — AC-T7)' as part of the broader zero-touch set. The strict AC-T7 wording (tech-spec.md:415) lists only auth.global.ts / SecurityConfig.java / JobRunrMongoConfig.java, so the strict AC passes — but the architectural intent ('No changes') was relaxed without an AC update.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) ratify the EventService extension in tech-spec.md Architecture by removing it from the zero-touch set (and document the new blocking-variant pattern for downstream cron jobs), or (b) leave the deviation recorded in decisions.md Task 4 and treat the broader list as advisory. Option (a) is preferred for future-proofing — the new blocking variant is a useful pattern other cron jobs will reuse.
findings.cross_reference: decisions.md Task 4 'Ordering-hazard fix' section explicitly documents this choice and rejects the alternative of injecting EventRepository into ProjectHardDeleteJob.

findings.issue: `currentUserId()`, `capUserAgent()`, and `extractIp()` are duplicated byte-for-byte from `ProfileController` (lines 75-95 there). The comment at ProjectController:124 explicitly defers extraction: 'Copied verbatim from ProfileController. A shared util is deferred (no other consumer yet).' With the addition of ProjectController, there are now 2 consumers, so the original deferral rationale has been satisfied.
findings.recommendation: Hoist `currentUserId()` to a shared utility (e.g. `common/SecurityUtils.java` or a `WebExchangeContext` helper) before Wave 2 epics (`04-bots`, `05-subscribers`, ...) start. Each new project-scoped controller will currently re-copy this code. Doing it once now is cheaper than refactoring N call sites later. `capUserAgent` and `extractIp` belong with the same hoist.

findings.issue: Timezone dropdown source + Zod refine over `Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone')` is duplicated between `pages/projects/new.vue` and `pages/projects/[projectId]/settings.vue:31-52`. The two implementations also drift: `settings.vue:31-36` has a graceful fallback for old Safari where `Intl.supportedValuesOf` is missing; `new.vue:13` calls it directly without a guard, which would throw on the same browsers.
findings.recommendation: Extract a shared composable `useTimezoneOptions()` returning `{ timezones, isValid }`. Mount both pages on it. Single source of truth for old-Safari degradation and Zod refine matches the codebase's existing 'reactive Zod schema' pattern (patterns.md).

findings.issue: Active-only filter (`p.deletedAt === null`) and createdAt-desc sort are repeated across three call sites: `stores/projects.ts:35,58` (`sortByCreatedAtDesc` helper + `runAutoSelect` filter), `components/ProjectSelector.vue:17-25` (filter + sort), `pages/projects/index.vue:63` (filter; sort by deletedAt is field-different but same comparator shape).
findings.recommendation: Expose `activeProjects` and `activeProjectsByCreatedAtDesc` as Pinia getters on the projects store. Components/pages consume the getters and remain thin. Eliminates three drift surfaces and centralizes the 'active' definition.

findings.issue: `projectsStore.fetchAll()` is fire-and-forget without `.catch()` on dashboard mount. A transient backend error here surfaces as an unhandled promise rejection in the console — not user-facing damage, but noisy in dev and an observability gap in prod. `pages/projects/[projectId]/settings.vue:19-23` correctly wraps the same call with `.catch()` (per Task 8 review fix); `pages/projects/index.vue:55-58` also fires without `.catch()` (same pattern).
findings.recommendation: Either (a) make the store's `fetchAll` swallow errors internally (set `isLoaded=true` and an `error` ref the UI binds to), or (b) standardize on `.catch(console.warn)` at every call site. Option (a) is cleaner — centralizes the policy in the store instead of repeating it at consumer pages.
findings.cross_reference: decisions.md Task 8 — settings.vue added `.catch()` defensively, dashboard.vue / projects/index.vue did not.

findings.issue: `findByIdAndOwnerId(String id, String ownerId)` is declared on the repository but never called from `ProjectService` or any other source file. The ownership check lives in `ProjectService.requireOwned` (line 50-64) via `findById(...)` + manual `ownerId.equals(...)`.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) delete the unused derived finder, or (b) refactor `requireOwned` to use it (which collapses the foreign-owner branch into a single Mongo query). Option (b) yields ~3 fewer lines in `requireOwned` and one fewer document fetch in the foreign-owner case. The current pattern is intentional only if a future caller needs the raw 'is this id mine?' check without the soft-delete branch — but no such caller exists.

findings.issue: Soft-deleted listing is fetched via `useApi()` directly inside the page (`refreshSoftDeleted`) instead of through a Pinia store action. The store does not expose a dedicated slot for soft-deleted projects today — `fetchAll(true)` would write them into `projects[]`, conflating active and soft-deleted state. The page therefore keeps a page-local `softDeletedProjects` ref.
findings.recommendation: Add `softDeletedProjects` ref + `fetchSoftDeleted()` action to the projects store. Pages consume the store; the 'all listings go through useApi + store' rule from the audit theme becomes cleanly enforced. Not blocking — current pattern uses `useApi()` (not raw `$fetch`) and is documented in decisions.md Task 7.

findings.issue: `handleApiResponseError` writes `projectsStore.pendingBannerKey = 'errors.projects.unavailable'` directly to the public reactive ref. This is documented in decisions.md Task 5 as intentional (the store exposes it as a public ref instead of a setter). Direct mutation works in Pinia setup-style stores, but it leaks the 'how to update the banner' detail into every consumer.
findings.recommendation: Add a thin `setPendingBanner(key)` / `clearPendingBanner()` action pair on the store, and convert the public `pendingBannerKey` to a getter. Aligns with the rest of the store API (every other state change goes through an action). Not blocking — present pattern is documented and works.

findings.issue: `requireOwned` is the single ownership entry point as required. Verified — only `ownerId.equals(project.getOwnerId())` call in `com.botfunnel.project.*` lives on line 56 inside `requireOwned`. Controller delegates every project-scoped handler to `requireOwned` before mutation (lines 60, 102, 141, 154 of `ProjectController` / `ProjectService.update/softDelete/restore`).
findings.recommendation: Maintain this invariant. Add a code-style rule (or PR-review checklist note) that any new project-scoped service method must start with `requireOwned(...)`. Future epics should treat this as a hard architectural rule.

findings.issue: `@JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = true)` whitelist is applied consistently to `CreateProjectRequest`, `UpdateProjectRequest`, and (implicitly via no extra fields) `ProjectResponse`. Mass-assignment defense (Risk R2) holds across all request DTOs — `ownerId`, `id`, `deletedAt` cannot be set by a client.
findings.recommendation: No action. Note: `ProjectResponse` has no `ownerId` field (line 5 comment explicitly forbids it) — response-shape lock is also in place. Document this as the Wave 2 DTO baseline for downstream epics.
findings.cross_reference: tech-spec.md Risk 2 + Architecture / Risks. patterns.md DTO whitelist pattern.

findings.issue: 404 interceptor regex `/^\/api\/v1\/projects\/([^/]+)$/` is correctly anchored at both ends and only fires when extracted ID equals `currentProjectId`. Sub-paths like `/api/v1/projects/{id}/bots` and the collection `/api/v1/projects` correctly do NOT match. Decision 11 / Risk R7 is implemented per spec.
findings.recommendation: No action. Verify-with-tests holds (Task 5 ships 9+ interceptor specs covering trailing slash, absolute URL, sub-path, foreign ID, non-404 status — see decisions.md Task 5 verification).
findings.cross_reference: tech-spec.md Decision 11 + Architecture / How it works (Stale currentProjectId self-healing).

findings.issue: AC-17b cascade ordering correctly implemented: (1) sweep prior events for deletedIds via typed `Criteria.where('metadata.projectId').in(deletedIds)`, (2) emit one `project_hard_deleted` event per project via the new `EventService.logEventBlocking(...).block()`, (3) drop project documents. The `.block()` calls enforce the temporal sandwich required by AC-17b. No untyped strings — `deletedIds` is `List<String>` and `_id` uses typed `.in(List<String>)`.
findings.recommendation: No action. Note for downstream cron jobs: replicate the `logEventBlocking(...).block()` pattern when AC-style 'event survives cascade' requirements appear. Recording here so future cron-author audits see the precedent.
findings.cross_reference: tech-spec.md Architecture / Hard-delete cron. decisions.md Task 4 'Ordering-hazard fix'.

cross_cutting_summary.duplicate_resource_initialization: None at the heavy-resource level (MongoTemplate, WebClient, Pinia stores are singletons via Spring DI / Pinia singleton). Mild duplication of utility helpers and view-layer filters — see F2, F3, F4.
cross_cutting_summary.shared_resources_compliance: `ProjectService.requireOwned` is the platform-wide isolation primitive (verified — F9). No second ownership check anywhere in `com.botfunnel.project.*`.
cross_cutting_summary.dto_whitelist_pattern: Applied consistently to both request DTOs (F10). Response DTO has no `ownerId` field (response-shape lock).
cross_cutting_summary.currentUserId_reuse: Used identically in `ProjectController` and `ProfileController`; byte-for-byte copy with explicit deferred-extraction comment. Ready for extraction (F2).
cross_cutting_summary.anti_enumeration_404: Uniform across foreign / soft-deleted / malformed / restore-on-active paths via `requireOwned` and `restore`'s deletedAt-FIRST guard (verified in `ProjectService.java:50-64,160-162`).
cross_cutting_summary.event_service_audit_emission: Service-layer for normal mutations (create / update / softDelete / restore). Cron-side emission in `ProjectHardDeleteJob` via new blocking variant of EventService — see F1 / F12.
cross_cutting_summary.frontend_store_boundary: All API access in pages/components goes through `useApi()` composable; no raw `$fetch` in `frontend/pages/` or `frontend/components/`. `pages/projects/index.vue:36` calls `useApi()` directly instead of via store action — see F7.
cross_cutting_summary.404_interceptor_safety: Path regex correctly anchored to single-resource pattern; ID-match guard prevents over-reach (F11).
cross_cutting_summary.i18n_parity: Zero drift between uk.json and en.json after Wave 1-3 (F13).
